Kimi K3.1 Pro is Moonshot AI's trillion-parameter sparse flagship, whose API opened on 23 October and whose weights — about 1.56 TB of them — became public on 4 November.

Built on a “tri-hybrid” design that weaves short convolutions, sliding-window attention, and global attention, the suite packs text, vision, audio, omni, and decision capabilities into roughly 2-billion-parameter footprints.
The startup released its LFM3 lineup on Oct. 27, rolling out six open-weight models anchored by a 1.7-billion-parameter base.
